title: Deploy new Grafana alert rules without a manual group bootstrap
reason: Requests automatic bootstrap of Grafana alert-rule groups in tldraw's production infrastructure workflow. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's repository does not use the cited Grafana resources deployment or tldraw alert provisioning behavior. This is upstream operations tooling, not a local release or product defect.

title: Improve how @tldraw/mermaid converts and integrates diagrams
reason: Collects and prioritizes fixes and feature requests for tldraw's dedicated Mermaid-to-native-shapes conversion package. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not currently import Mermaid source or convert its diagram database into editable scene nodes. The issues grouped under this parent are potential capabilities only if a Mermaid integration is separately scoped; the upstream package defects cannot manifest in the current product.

title: Converting a mermaid diagram overwrites the host app's mermaid configuration
reason: Reports a module-level configuration mutation in `@tldraw/mermaid` when it initializes Mermaid for each conversion; the issue is code-inspected but not yet reproduced in a host app. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no Mermaid conversion package or Mermaid singleton configuration to preserve. This host-app integration hazard does not map to current Varve code.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no Mermaid conversion package or Mermaid singleton configuration to preserve.

title: Add automated readability checks for converted mermaid diagrams
reason: Proposes geometry-based automated readability checks for converted diagrams after several visual layout repairs were found by screenshot inspection. No comments were available.
assessment: This test suite would validate the output of a Mermaid converter Varve does not ship. Varve's existing diagram and layout tests cover its own primitives, but the upstream issue does not identify a local visual regression.

varveAssessment.assessment: This test suite would validate the output of a Mermaid converter Varve does not ship. Varve's existing diagram and layout tests cover its own primitives, but the upstream issue does not identify a local visual regression.

title: Long labels can overflow their shapes in converted mermaid diagrams
reason: Reports mismatched text metrics between Mermaid's offscreen layout and tldraw's hand-drawn rendering, causing converted flowchart and mind-map labels to exceed their shape bounds. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no Mermaid offscreen layout pipeline or shape conversion based on its font measurements. Its own text layout and scene rendering share canonical metrics, so this cross-renderer sizing defect has no direct local path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no Mermaid offscreen layout pipeline or shape conversion based on its font measurements. Its own text layout and scene rendering share canonical metrics, so this cross-renderer sizing defect has no direct local path.

title: Crossing or parallel mermaid edges can get each other's curves
reason: The sole comment corrects the original crossing-edge hypothesis: the cited crossing cases match Mermaid; only edges sharing both endpoints are affected, which is covered by #10826.
assessment: Varve has no Mermaid-to-native-edge conversion that matches paths from Mermaid's rendered SVG. The corrected upstream endpoint-matching case is not a local path-routing or curve-assignment defect.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no Mermaid-to-native-edge conversion that matches paths from Mermaid's rendered SVG.

title: Mermaid sequence diagram participant boxes are dropped
reason: Reports omission of sequence-diagram `box` group bands and their labels during native conversion. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not parse Mermaid sequence diagrams or expose imported participant-box metadata. Supporting this format would be a new diagram import capability, not a renderer repair.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not parse Mermaid sequence diagrams or expose imported participant-box metadata.

title: Mermaid sequence self-message labels are drawn on the loop instead of above it
reason: The sole comment closes the report as an intentional tradeoff: tldraw keeps labels attached to their arrows, while Mermaid places labels as detached text above a self-message loop.
assessment: The reported behavior is a deliberate upstream conversion-versus-editability choice and requires a Mermaid importer that Varve does not have. It is neither a local text-layout defect nor a clear parity requirement.

varveAssessment.assessment: The reported behavior is a deliberate upstream conversion-versus-editability choice and requires a Mermaid importer that Varve does not have.

title: Add native support for mermaid class diagrams
reason: Requests editable class, member, and relationship shapes instead of a flat SVG fallback for Mermaid class diagrams. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no Mermaid import feature or static-SVG fallback for diagram source. Native class-diagram conversion could be a future product capability, but requires a broader decision about Mermaid support, conversion semantics, editing, and export rather than a single issue fix.
